preregistration.name: nas100_weekly_vwap_reversion_v1
preregistration.hypothesis: Mean reversion to the weekly VWAP: when the Nasdaq 100 closes an hour at or beyond 2 volume-weighted standard deviations from the weekly VWAP, it moves back toward the VWAP over the next 6-12 hours (long below -2 sigma, short above +2 sigma).
preregistration.rationale: The user's own discretionary rule (reversion from +-2 deviation VWAP bands, used on the session VWAP in range days), transferred to the weekly anchor. Caveats declared in advance: Dukascopy tick volume (not CME volume) weights the VWAP; no range-day filter (the composite-profile regime is not available), so trend weeks are included; time exits only (no 'exit at VWAP').
preregistration.registered_by: X-QUANT, 2026-10-04, at the user's request to add the weekly VWAP; registered before any weekly-VWAP-based outcome was computed (only the band occupancy was looked at: -2: 7.1%, +2: 11.4% of bars)
variants: LONG when wvwap_band == -2; exit after 6 bars
LONG when wvwap_band == -2; exit after 12 bars
SHORT when wvwap_band == 2; exit after 6 bars
SHORT when wvwap_band == 2; exit after 12 bars
